exact: ER-Golgi intermediate compartment derived vesicle fusion with ER membrane
endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) derived vesicle fusion with ER membrane

definition: The joining of the lipid bilayer membrane around an ERGIC-derived vesicle to the lipid bilayer membrane of the ER. Such vesicles include COPI-coated transport vesicles involved in retrograde transport.
label: endoplasmic reticulum-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) derived vesicle fusion with endoplasmic reticulum membrane
